_comment: Cosmos DB audit container immutability policy.
This file documents the required immutable container configuration for the 'audit-partitioned' container.
The 'audit-partitioned' container stores ADR-015 Tier 2 compliance records for AI interactions.
Retention: 7 years (legal compliance requirement).
Immutability: container-level policy prevents updates and deletes at the data plane.
AIR2-074 RE-KEY (FR-D-05): the active audit container was re-keyed off bare '/tenantId' onto a
synthetic '/partitionKey' value '{tenantId}|{yyyy-MM}' (tenant + monthly time bucket) to stay
under the Cosmos 20 GB logical-partition cap in customer-dedicated deployments. Cosmos partition
keys cannot change in place, so this is a NEW container ('audit-partitioned') with the write path
cut over in AuditLogService.cs. The predecessor 'audit' container (partition '/tenantId') is NOT
retired and NOT re-keyed — its historical append-only compliance records are left intact and
retain their own immutability policy (documented under 'legacyContainer' below). Migration of
existing records is a NON-DESTRUCTIVE copy-forward operator step (see the AIR2-074 migration note
in projects/spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r2/notes/). Existing audit data is never deleted or
rewritten.
IMPORTANT: The application code in AuditLogService.cs enforces append-only semantics
by using CreateItemAsync exclusively. This infrastructure policy provides a second,
independent enforcement layer that protects audit records even if application code
is modified or a data contributor role is used directly.
To apply this policy, use the Azure Portal or Azure CLI (see commands below).
Note: Cosmos DB point-in-time restore immutability policies are currently preview.
Reference: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/cosmos-db/access-control-resource-token-api

container.name: audit-partitioned
container.partitionKeyValueFormat: {tenantId}|{yyyy-MM}  (synthetic tenant + monthly time bucket — AIR2-074/FR-D-05; never bare /tenantId)

immutabilityPolicy._comment: Cosmos DB immutability policy (Time-Based Retention). Set at provisioning time.

_comment: Predecessor container, RETAINED read-only after the AIR2-074 re-key. Not retired, not re-keyed,
never migrated destructively — append-only Tier-2 compliance data. New writes go to
'audit-partitioned'; historical records remain queryable here (and, once the operator runs the
non-destructive copy-forward, also in 'audit-partitioned').
legacyContainer.name: audit

rbac._comment: Only Cosmos DB Built-in Data Reader role should be assigned for audit reads.
rbac.writeRole: Cosmos DB Built-in Data Contributor (restricted to CreateItemAsync by application code)
rbac.noDeleteRole: DeleteItemAsync and ReplaceItemAsync are blocked by immutability policy

_comment: Operator steps for the AIR2-074 re-key. NON-DESTRUCTIVE: create the new container and copy
existing records forward while the legacy 'audit' container remains intact. Nothing is deleted
or rewritten in 'audit'. Run these against live infra (this project declares infra in bicep and
reports the commands rather than mutating live Cosmos).
deploymentCommands.createNewContainer: az cosmosdb sql container create --account-name spe-cosmos-dev-ai --database-name spaarke-ai --resource-group spe-infrastructure-westus2 --name audit-partitioned --partition-key-path /partitionKey --ttl -1   # OR re-run infrastructure/bicep/modules/cosmos-db.bicep (auditPartitionedContainer resource)
deploymentCommands.verifyNewContainer: az cosmosdb sql container show --account-name spe-cosmos-dev-ai --database-name spaarke-ai --name audit-partitioned --resource-group spe-infrastructure-westus2 --query 'resource.partitionKey.paths'
deploymentCommands.migrateExistingDataNonDestructive: COPY-FORWARD ONLY (never move/delete). While the container is small, copy each legacy 'audit' doc into 'audit-partitioned' recomputing partitionKey = `${tenantId}|${yyyy-MM(timestamp)}` and writing via CreateItem. Suggested tool: `az cosmosdb copy` (intra-account container copy job) or a scripted read-from-audit → create-into-audit-partitioned pass. Leave 'audit' untouched.
deploymentCommands.escalationIfLarge: If 'audit' has grown large enough that copy-forward is not cheap/safe (data-movement + RU cost), STOP and choose 'leave-legacy': new writes already target 'audit-partitioned'; historical reads continue against the legacy 'audit' container for the remainder of its 7-year retention. Surface the measured size to the operator (AIR2-074 escalation trigger).
deploymentCommands.verifyLegacyImmutability: az cosmosdb sql container show --account-name spe-cosmos-dev-ai --database-name spaarke-ai --name audit --resource-group spe-infrastructure-westus2 --query 'resource.defaultTtl'
deploymentCommands.applyImmutabilityViaBicep: See infrastructure/bicep/modules/cosmos-db.bicep — add immutabilityPolicy to the auditPartitionedContainer resource block when GA.
